svg.text: Day 18 - multi-GPU kernel-DAG scheduler (hardware command processor)
green = datapath / graph words · amber = control · red = interrupt · MAX_NODES=64, DEVICES=4
w1..w2 dep mask · w3 kernel id
w0 start tick · w1 finish tick
1 tick / clock in RUN, no bus
rem == 0 on a busy slot → retire at end of tick: done bit and freed slot both appear next tick
comp_valid[3:0] + comp_node → done_mask, finish = start + dur + 1
the graph has a cycle. No timeout.
every tick is exactly one of
AXI4-Lite MEMORY MASTER: ARADDR/RDATA (graph fetch) · AWADDR/WDATA/BRESP (result writeback)
FETCH: one node record per 4 words, validated as it lands
host lays the graph out once per launch
memory read pipeline: up to OUTSTANDING = 4 addresses in flight (f_issue - f_ack), reads return in order - no reorder buffer needed
writeback: up to 4 beats in flight (w_issue - w_ack); the result word mux is combinational, so no drain FIFO is required
RUN phase: zero bus traffic, one tick per clock - the schedule is a function of the graph alone, not of memory timing
